nodes.label: Academic-corporate design brief
nodes.rationale: Deep royal blue + berry palette authored in OKLCH with neutrals tinted toward the brand hue, light mode, editorial/Swiss layout, Philosopher + Mulish + JetBrains Mono typefaces, targeting a WCAG 2.1 AA baseline; full brief kept in .impeccable.md.

nodes.label: Content-as-data pattern
nodes.rationale: All copy lives in src/data/ (nav.ts, frameworks.ts, days.ts) so pages render fixed shapes; adding real lecture content means editing data rather than JSX, and empty slots render a <Placeholder> until real content lands.
